Talk: Rate limiting at the edge

12,304 views · Apr 10, 2026

Recorded at ExampleConf 2026. In this 40 minute talk we walk through the token bucket, the leaky bucket and sliding windows, and show how the RateLimit header fields let clients back off gracefully. Slides are linked below the player.
